items.title: AI Models Are Watermarking Text—Will You Notice?
items.summary: On 11 August, Anthropic announced that all future Claude models will generate text that contains a watermark that identifies its results as AI generated. The company is not alone. Google has its own text watermark (which Anthropic’s is based on) it uses on the output of its Gemini models. OpenAI has yet to introduce a text watermark but it plans to do so.
